prior_observer_diagnosis.cause: the legacy parser looked for counter as a sibling of rule.comment, but nft -j stores it in rule.expr; it therefore returned zero for every commented rule. The observed service real UID is 65534, so the skuid filter itself does not explain the historical zero
prior_observer_diagnosis.replacement: packet capture of target SYNs with distinct 4-tuple counting; retransmissions and capture duplicates do not add attempts
